Name: Willy Sells Smoker and Jellies
Author: imclueless0
Description: I really like smoking fish, but I don't like how much of a pain getting the materials to craft a smoker is (Cave Jellies...I hate trying to get Cave Jellies...). So I made this mod to help with that. Willy now sells smokers and the three fishing jellies. River Jelly will be available from level 1, Sea Jelly will be available at level 2 fishing, and Cave Jelly will be available at level 6 fishing. The prices can be adjusted in the content.json if you are so inclined, but I set the prices so that it would still feel meaningful to work toward getting.
